plain: The completion or final fulfilling of something

webster.text: Completion; end; perfection of a work, process or scheme.

more.text: The end or completion of the present system of things; the end of the world.

example.quote: He considered it as the panacea of America, whose healing power will pervade the continent, and sincerely believed hat its ratification is a consummation devoutly to be wished.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, South Carolina House of Representatives (debate on calling the convention), Hon. ROBERT BARNWELL, January 17, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
